job.value: judge whether this card is worth buying at this price

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: Card photo, title 'Mega Gengar ex 230/193…', 'S$29' and 'Buy' make this clearly a listing to buy.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The red 'Buy' button is the strongest control, with 'Add to cart' secondary.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Buy', 'Add to cart' and the heart predict, but 'Good Deal ›' has a chevron without saying it opens price insights.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Lightly Played' has an ⓘ, but 'Good Deal' gives no basis for the claim on the spot.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The buyer only weighs price and condition, both shown.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Condition detail sits behind 'Condition ⓘ' and pricing evidence behind 'Good Deal ›'.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything here helps the buy decision.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and values ('Condition', 'Card number', 'Set') carry the details; no paragraph.
